text:
alex_m: Scheduling Penrose on‑prem deploy for this Friday 03:00 UTC (2h maintenance window). Plan: DB snapshot, apply infra manifests, rotate certs, smoke checks, canary -> full. Need deploy lead + rollback owner. pinging @samira @jordan

samira: I can take deploy lead. I'll be on the call and reachable for the window.

jordan: I'll own rollback and the smoke test suite. Please add me to the runbook.

emily_t: I can handle cert rotation and Vault pulls. Confirm we have new certs at secrets/penrose/certs/v2026-03.

alex_m: Runbook here: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/penrose-onprem-deploy — also preflight checklist below.

alex_m: ```
# preflight
kubectl -n penrose get pods --no-headers
kubectl -n penrose exec deploy/redwood-inference -- curl -fsS localhost:8080/health
./smoke_tests/run_smoke.sh --host penrose.local --token $SMOKE_TOKEN
```

ryan_k: I'll handle monitoring & post-deploy alerts (Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/penrose). I'll add an alert for 5xx rate and P95 latency.

ops-bot: Reminder set: deploy scheduled by alex_m for 1779991122 — 2h pre-reminder will fire.

samira: Customer SRE (penrose-sre) confirmed the window earlier today — they want a 10min heads-up before any DB snapshot. Alex, can you handle that?

alex_m: Yep, I'll DM them 10min before snapshot. Also plan to deploy to penrose-canary first (10% traffic) for 15m validation before promoting.

jordan: Canary + smoke: I'll run the smoke suite and validate inference traces. If error rate > 1% or P95 jumps > 200ms in 5m, we roll back. Rollback command: `./rollback/penrose_rollback.sh` (I will be owner).

emily_t: Note: migration job needs job-memory: 4Gi — previous run OOMed at 2Gi. Samira, please ensure manifest updated.

samira: Opening PR for manifests now: https://git.internal/repos/infra/penrose-manifests/pull/123 — includes cert path and job-memory bump.

ryan_k: Quick code review ping @alex_m @jordan — need one approval to merge before 02:00 UTC.

alex_m: Reviewed and left a small nit — fixed. Approved.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Penrose on‑prem deploy" Fri 03:00 UTC (attendees: alex_m, samira, jordan, emily_t, ryan_k).

alex_m: Thanks. I'll merge PR at 02:00 UTC, run preflight at 02:30, and start the canary at 03:00. If no major issues after 15m, promote to full.

samira: :thumbsup:

jordan: :eyes:

emily_t: I'll be standing by for cert rotation and Vault ops.

alex_m: One more thing — backup retention: we keep snapshots for 7 days, snapshot script: `scripts/penrose_snapshot.sh`. I'll kick it at 02:45.

samira: All set from infra side. See you all Friday.

jordan: Got it. Rolling owner checked in.

ryan_k: I'll watch dashboards and post an incident channel if anything spikes.

alex_m: Great — thanks team. If anything changes, update thread.
